high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "blank_slate_home." The post is sponsored and features a copper bottle set with two glasses, all decorated with a floral pattern. The bottle and glasses have a beige background with red and green floral designs. The bottle has a metallic cap, while the glasses have a copper rim. The setting appears to be a clean, minimalist surface, possibly a marble countertop, with a few decorative items placed around it: a pine cone, a dried leaf, and a book titled "Mumbai" by Rana Mehta.
